subject: Pricing follow-up: commitment options, $/1M target & startup credit
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Shah <aisha@forefrontai.com>, Samir Patel <samir@forefrontai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + ask: commitment pathing, $/1M target & startup credit

Hi Aisha / Samir — thanks again for the product walkthrough earlier. Quick recap and a few asks so we can put a firm quote together: 

Call highlights
- Use case: high-throughput generative summarization for enterprise docs; latency target ~150–200ms p95 per request.
- Current expected traffic: roughly 25–35M tokens/month initially, scaling to ~60M in Q4 if the pilot goes well.
- Key constraint: internal procurement is aiming for a predictable unit cost; they gave a target of approximately $1.5k per 1M tokens (ballpark).

Asks / next steps
1) Can you confirm a realistic monthly token range to price against? (Your note of 25–35M is perfect; if you expect spikes, call them out.)
2) Tell us the procurement time horizon you prefer: month-to-month, 3 month commit, 12 month commit? Committed months materially change the unit economics.
3) Are you eligible for a startup program / founder credit? If so confirm the entity and any validation steps.

What I will do: attach a short mutual action plan (MAP) and the demo recording, and sketch 2 pricing paths (starter/commit) for you to review. If you confirm the monthly range and target $/1M, I’ll follow up with formal quote options and the startup credit process.

Attachments: mutual-action-plan.pdf (MAP), demo-recording-20260721.mp4

Thanks — talk soon,
Priya Natarajan
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
priya@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0163

From: Aisha Shah <aisha@forefrontai.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@forefrontai.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2026 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + ask: commitment pathing, $/1M target & startup credit

Thanks Priya — appreciated the clear recap. Confirming the numbers from our side:
- Pilot month expected: 30M tokens (average), with burst spikes to ~45M for experiments.
- If pilot metrics look good, plan is to move to 50–60M/month sustained over the next 6–12 months.
- Procurement preference: we prefer a 12-month committed path but can do a 3-month pilot first if needed to validate.
- Budget guidance: leadership gave a target of ~$1.4–1.8k per 1M tokens depending on SLA/throughput guarantees. Our preferred target is $1.5k/1M.

We are a seed-stage company; we should qualify for startup credits — I’m the point of contact for that. Happy to share incorporation docs and an investor reference.

Next step for you: a sketch with (A) a startup + short-term pilot offer and (B) a 12-month committed offer with unit economics laid out. Prefer to see line items for GPU-backed hosted inference vs. dedicated pools if pricing differs.

Best,
Aisha Shah
Head of Product, Forefront AI
aisha@forefrontai.com

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Shah <aisha@forefrontai.com>, Samir Patel <samir@forefrontai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Jul 2026 09:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + ask: commitment pathing, $/1M target & startup credit

Thanks Aisha — helpful. Attached is an initial pricing sketch (pricing-options.xlsx) and a MAP that maps milestones to approvals and dates. High level options (sketch):

Option A — Pilot / Startup path- Pilot: 3-month trial window (month-to-month during pilot)- One-time startup credit: $12,000 in service credit applied to first 3 months (validation required: incorporation docs + investor reference)- Unit price during pilot: $2,100 / 1M tokens (hosted) — post-credit effective unit price depends on consumption; we’ll show blended examples in the spreadsheet

Option B — 12-month committed path (preferred for unit economics)- 12-month commit at 45M tokens/month (you can front-load usage into early months up to a cap)- Committed discount: 18% off list (hosted) which nets to $1,722 / 1M tokens at our standard list — with autoscaling SLA and reserved burst capacity- Multi-year incentive: additional 7% on top if you commit to year 2 at signing (total 25% across first 24 months) — requires leadership approval (I’m looping Ben + Vivek).

Notes:
- Dedicated capacity pricing will be provided line-by-line in the spreadsheet; short summary: dedicated pools reduce per-token cost by ~15–25% depending on quantization and q8a use.
- If your target is $1.5k/1M, the 12-month + year-2 incentive path can get you close (we’ll show modeled scenarios).

Next actions
- Aisha: confirm you can provide incorporation + investor reference for startup credit.
- Samir: confirm whether you prefer hosted or evaluate dedicated in the pilot (we can include both).
- I will loop in Ben + Vivek for approval on the multi-year incentive and return a formal quote + DocuSign once we agree on a path.

Attachments: pricing-options.xlsx, mutual-action-plan.pdf, demo-recording-20260721.mp4

Regards,
Priya Natarajan
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Jul 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Pricing follow-up: commitment options, $/1M target & startup credit

Ben / Vivek / Marissa — forwarding the Forefront AI thread. Quick summary for approvals and guidance:
- Forefront is seed-stage, expected 30M/month in pilot, plans to scale to 50–60M/month within 6–12 months.
- Target unit economics requested: ~$1.5k / 1M tokens.
- I’ve proposed: startup credit $12k + Pilot unit price (hosted) $2,100/1M; OR 12-month commit at 18% off (nets $1,722/1M) + additional 7% if they commit to year 2 now (25% total first 24 months).

Request: can we approve the 7% multi-year incentive on top of a 12-month committment for Forefront? If not fully approvable, what floor discount should we offer to hit near $1.5k blended?

Related links: HubSpot deal RDW-2026-0387, pricing-options.xlsx attached.

Thanks,
Priya

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 24 Jul 2026 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pricing follow-up: commitment options, $/1M target & startup credit

Priya — thanks for the clear ask and the MAP. Quick callouts / decision:
- Approve the $12k startup credit for this seed-stage customer (standard validation).
- For the multi-year incentive: I can approve a 20% gross discount on year 1 if they sign a 12-month commitment at a baseline of >=45M tokens/month. If they want to tier down to 30–44M/month we should offer 15% year 1. The additional year-2 commitment bonus (to reach 25% total) needs finance signoff but I’m comfortable taking it to finance.
- If they remain hosted (no dedicated), propose a 12-mo quote with 45M committed and a clause to renegotiate if usage falls below 70% of committed baseline.

I’ll draft a formal quote and send a DocuSign with the approved 20% path and the pilot + startup credit as an appendix. Priya — please add the incorporation + investor ref once Aisha provides them and I’ll include the startup credit in the quote.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com
